instrument_name: CT OLR report 2017-R-0237 New York City and Philadelphia Income Taxes (Connecticut municipalities section)
authority: Connecticut General Assembly Office of Legislative Research
article_or_section: Ability of Connecticut Municipalities to Levy Income Taxes
figure_or_rule_carried: State law allows municipalities to levy property tax and several narrower taxes; it does not explicitly allow income taxes; CT municipalities have only powers expressly conferred (Old Colony Gardens v. Stamford, 147 Conn. 60 (1959); Pepin v. Danbury, 171 Conn. 74 (1976)). So no local income/wage tax in CT. Report dated 2017 (age caveat); consistent with absence in IP 2026(1) (US-CT-P5-1-004)
